fusions.name: Unrefined Torrent
fusions.desc: Pours raw arcana through a narrow cone 5 tiles long, which deals 30 damage to everything in it, ignoring resistances.

fusions.name: Overcharged Knuckles
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. The strike deals 9 damage and leaves the target [Unravelling] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance to leave it [Exposed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wring Out the Reserve
fusions.desc: Forces raw arcana back into you, restoring 25 mana at once.

fusions.name: Mana Into Muscle
fusions.desc: When you spend mana, your physical damage rises 25% for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
